## Notebook Overview

**Inputs:**

- `../../../data/acs_step2_2016_tract.feather` — 2012–2016 ACS measures on `tr2010_id`.
- `../../../data/acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.feather` — 2020–2024 block-group measures aggregated to `tr2010_id`.
- `../../../data/acs_step2_2024_tract.feather` — Census-reported 2020–2024 tract measures on native `tr2020_id`.
- `../../../data/xwalk_tr20_tr10.feather` — statewide geographic-consistency flags and explicit tract links, keyed by `tr2020_id`.
- Existing `../../../data/acs_full.feather`, if saving is enabled and the file is present — column/type reference read before saving.

**Outputs:**

- Notebook-only `acs_diagnostics` and coverage, source-selection, source/change,
  and rental-inventory comparisons.
- Optional `../../../data/acs_full.feather` — 2016 and selected 2024 measures on
  `tr2010_id`, with inflation-adjusted dollars, changes, uncertainty, and
  year-specific rent status/flags/censoring bounds and source/quality fields. See the [panel schema](schemas/acs_full.md) for columns
  and §1.3 for write controls.

**Steps:**

1. Set up environment
2. Import and prepare survey measures
3. Merge surveys, select canonical 2024 measures, and calculate changes
4. Review geographic coverage and source-selection QA
5. Compare 2024 sources and implied changes (diagnostic only)
6. Compare occupied renter units and rental inventory (diagnostic only)
7. Validate the panel and optionally save

Step 2 supplies measures for the 14 configured Southern California and Bay Area
counties. This notebook checks that coverage, merges the inputs, and derives
changes without further sample restrictions.

# 1. Set up environment

## 1.1 Load packages

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(here)          # project-root-relative paths via here::here()
library(Hmisc)
library(dplyr)
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(spatstat)
library(matrixStats)
library(survey)
library(srvyr)
```

## 1.2 Load helper functions

```{r load-helpers}
source(here::here("R", "rent_metadata.R"))
source(here::here("R", "merge_helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "geography_qa.R"))
source(here::here("R", "merge_diagnostics.R"))
```

## 1.3 Set data directory and optional output write

Saving is enabled below. For diagnostic review, set `write_panel <- FALSE`
before running from setup; all in-memory validation still runs. With `TRUE`,
§7.5 announces and writes/replaces `acs_full.feather`, then checks the saved file.

```{r set-paths}
data_dir <- here::here("..", "..", "..", "data")
write_panel <- TRUE
prior_panel_path <- file.path(data_dir, "acs_full.feather")
prior_panel <- if (isTRUE(write_panel) && file.exists(prior_panel_path)) {
  arrow::read_feather(prior_panel_path)
} else NULL
```

# 2. Import and prepare survey measures

## 2.1 Load and prepare 2020–2024 block-group-aggregated measures

Preserve source measures under `_24_bg_agg` names for selection and comparison,
including `interp_rent_24_bg_agg`; prepare the panel's year-suffixed fields.

### Decision: Retain upstream structure counts as levels

Use upstream `smfE`, `sfd_detE`, `mf5E`, and `nsfaE` counts directly to preserve
their zeros, missingness, and fractional allocations. These are levels only;
2024 levels follow the source selection in §3.2.

```{r prep-24-bg-agg}
acs_24_bg_agg <- load_data(data_dir, NULL, "acs_step2_2024_block_group_aggregated.feather")
report_n(acs_24_bg_agg, "2024 block-group-aggregated measures loaded")
assert_merge_measures(acs_24_bg_agg, "tr2010_id", "2024 block-group panel input", source = "bg_agg")
input_keys_24_bg_agg <- acs_24_bg_agg$tr2010_id
acs_24_bg_agg_diagnostic <- prepare_2024_source(acs_24_bg_agg, "bg_agg")

acs_24_bg_agg <- rename_vars(acs_24_bg_agg, "24", source = "bg_agg")

var_list <- c("pct_miss_rent", "tc_flag_rent_24", "rent_status_24", "rent_censor_bound_24", "interp_rent")
acs_24_bg_agg <- select_vars(acs_24_bg_agg, "24", var_list)
```

## 2.2 Load Census-reported 2020–2024 tract measures

Retain native 2020 keys and upstream estimates under `_24_tract` names for
selection and diagnostics, preserving source censoring.

```{r prep-24-tract}
acs_24_tract <- load_data(data_dir, NULL, "acs_step2_2024_tract.feather")
report_n(acs_24_tract, "2024 Census tract measures loaded")
assert_merge_measures(acs_24_tract, "tr2020_id", "2024 Census tract input")
input_keys_24_tract <- acs_24_tract$tr2020_id
acs_24_tract_diagnostic <- prepare_2024_source(acs_24_tract, "tract")
assert_tract_keys(acs_24_tract_diagnostic, input_keys_24_tract,
                  "Prepared Census tract diagnostics", key = "tr2020_id")
```

## 2.3 Load and prepare 2012–2016 measures

### Decision: Inflation-adjust 2016 dollars to 2024 dollars

Multiply 2016 dollar estimates and their MOEs by **1.307** so changes compare
real values. Apply the same parameter to `rent_censor_bound_16`: the $3,500
source bound becomes $4,574.50 under the current factor. Flags and statuses
remain unchanged; the 2024 bound remains $3,500. The factor is the ratio of BLS CPI-U annual averages (U.S. city
average, all items): 313.689 (2024) / 240.007 (2016) ≈ 1.307.

```{r prep-16}
acs_16 <- load_data(data_dir, NULL, "acs_step2_2016_tract.feather")
report_n(acs_16, "2016 tract measures loaded")
assert_merge_measures(acs_16, "tr2010_id", "2016 panel input")
input_keys_16 <- acs_16$tr2010_id
acs_16_diagnostic <- acs_16 |>
  select(tr2010_id, rentE, rhuE, rhu_inventoryE) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_16"), -tr2010_id)
panel_counties <- sort(unique(substr(input_keys_16, 3, 5)))
stopifnot("Run stage 2 with all 14 configured counties before merging" = length(panel_counties) == 14L)
report_tract_counties(acs_16, panel_counties, "2016 input counties (validated in stage 2)")
report_tract_counties(acs_24_bg_agg, panel_counties, "2024 block-group destination counties")
report_tract_counties(acs_24_tract, panel_counties, "2024 Census tract counties", key = "tr2020_id")

acs_16 <- rename_vars(acs_16, "16")

var_list <- c("m_flag_lqcrent", "m_flag_rhu", "m_flag_med_hval",
               "zero_flag_rhu", "tc_flag_lqcrent", "tc_flag_med_hval")
acs_16 <- select_vars(acs_16, "16", var_list)

# Compare rent before and after inflation adjustment.
summary(acs_16$rentE_16)
rent_metadata_before_inflation <- acs_16[rent_metadata_columns("16")]
acs_16 <- infl_adj_vars(acs_16, "16")
stopifnot(identical(acs_16[c("tc_flag_rent_16", "rent_status_16")],
                    rent_metadata_before_inflation[c("tc_flag_rent_16", "rent_status_16")]),
          identical(acs_16$rent_censor_bound_16,
                    rent_metadata_before_inflation$rent_censor_bound_16 * inflation_factor_2016()))
assert_rent_metadata(acs_16, "rentE_16", "16", 3500 * inflation_factor_2016())
summary(acs_16$rentE_16)
stopifnot(identical(acs_16_diagnostic$tr2010_id, acs_16$tr2010_id))
acs_16_diagnostic$rentE_16 <- acs_16$rentE_16
```

## 2.4 Load and validate geographic-consistency links

### Decision: Use documented consistency flags and explicit links

Use Step 3's consistency flags and explicit 2010–2020 links: consistent pairs
can have different GEOIDs. Collapse repeated split-status records only when
they agree. Merge/many-to-many records omit their 2010 partners, so unresolved
panel statuses remain `NA`; the crosswalk cannot fully classify the 2010 panel.

```{r load-geography}
tract_geography <- load_data(data_dir, NULL, "xwalk_tr20_tr10.feather")
report_n(tract_geography, "Statewide 2020-tract geographic-consistency input")
geography_links <- prepare_merge_geography(tract_geography)
print(table(tract_geography$geo_consistent, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(tract_geography$relationship_class, useNA = "ifany"))
```

Missing/unrecognized flags and class labels remain visible in QA; unknown labels
do not override a valid flag. Contradictory known classifications and ambiguous
links fail validation.

# 3. Merge surveys, select canonical 2024 measures, and calculate changes

## 3.1 Establish the panel from 2016 and block-group 2024 keys

### Decision: Retain the full union of survey keys

Full-join the 2016 and block-group 2024 inputs on `tr2010_id` to retain
one-period-only tracts, with one row per key. Native Census records supply
measurements through consistent links without expanding this union.

Review `panel_membership` for one-period-only tracts and county counts.
Membership uses the original input keys: `base_id` is constant `TRUE`, and
`post_id` indicates block-group input membership, independently of Census
measurement availability.

```{r merge-surveys}
n_16 <- nrow(acs_16)
n_24_bg_agg <- nrow(acs_24_bg_agg)
assert_tract_keys(acs_16, input_keys_16, "Prepared 2016 input")
assert_tract_keys(acs_24_bg_agg, input_keys_24_bg_agg, "Prepared 2024 block-group input")
acs_16_24_bg_agg <- merge_df(acs_16, acs_24_bg_agg)
table(acs_16_24_bg_agg$merge)
panel_membership <- audit_panel_keys(acs_16_24_bg_agg, input_keys_16, input_keys_24_bg_agg)
cat(sprintf("Merged %s (2016) and %s (2024 block-group) tracts -> %s panel rows\n",
            formatC(n_16, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
            formatC(n_24_bg_agg, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
            formatC(nrow(acs_16_24_bg_agg), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))

acs_16_24_bg_agg <- acs_16_24_bg_agg |>
  select(-c(merge)) |>
  mutate(base_id=TRUE)

acs_full <- acs_16_24_bg_agg |>
  mutate(rent_status_16 = coalesce(rent_status_16, "unresolved"))
```

## 3.2 Attach statuses and select canonical 2024 measures

Attach statuses and both sources to `acs_diagnostics`, preserving panel keys,
row order, and row counts. Only consistent links supply Census measurements.

```{r build-diagnostic-panel}
acs_diagnostics <- merge_diagnostic_left_join(
  acs_full, geography_links$statuses, "tr2010_id", "Attach available panel statuses"
)
acs_diagnostics <- merge_diagnostic_left_join(
  acs_diagnostics, geography_links$consistent, "tr2010_id", "Attach consistent Census links"
)
acs_diagnostics <- merge_diagnostic_left_join(
  acs_diagnostics, acs_24_bg_agg_diagnostic, "tr2010_id", "Attach block-group diagnostic measures"
)
acs_diagnostics <- merge_diagnostic_left_join(
  acs_diagnostics, acs_24_tract_diagnostic, "tr2020_id", "Attach consistent Census measures"
) |>
  mutate(
    in_16 = tr2010_id %in% input_keys_16,
    in_24_bg_agg = tr2010_id %in% input_keys_24_bg_agg,
    in_24_tract = tr2020_id %in% input_keys_24_tract,
    geo_status = case_when(geo_consistent == 1 ~ "consistent",
                           geo_consistent == 0 ~ "not_consistent", .default = NA_character_)
  )
assert_tract_keys(acs_diagnostics, union(input_keys_16, input_keys_24_bg_agg),
                  "Full diagnostic panel")
stopifnot("Canonical columns must remain identical" =
            identical(select(acs_diagnostics, all_of(names(acs_full))), acs_full))

acs_24_tract_geography <- merge_diagnostic_left_join(
  acs_24_tract_diagnostic,
  select(tract_geography, tr2020_id, geo_consistent, relationship_class),
  "tr2020_id", "Native Census tract coverage", left_key = "tr2020_id"
)
```

### Decision: Select whole bundles by geography, with no availability fallback

Only `geo_consistent == 1` establishes eligibility for Census tract estimates.
Select that source's estimates, MOEs, CVs, and quality flags together; use the
block-group bundle for every other row, including missing/unexpected flags.
`acs_source_24` records this assignment independently of availability. Preserve
the selected fields' values and missingness, including an observed MOE for a
censored estimate; never fill a missing selected field from the other source.

Canonical `interp_rent` follows the same rule, using native tract median gross
rent (`rentE_24_tract`) as the tract counterpart to block-group interpolation
(`interp_rent_24_bg_agg`). No tract interpolation is constructed.

Rent, `tc_flag_rent_24`, `rent_status_24`, and `rent_censor_bound_24` use the
same source mapping. An absent selected record is `unresolved`, with missing
rent/flag/bound and no fallback. An absent baseline is likewise `unresolved`.
`pct_miss_rent` remains corrected BG component coverage on every row.

```{r select-canonical-24}
acs_diagnostics <- select_canonical_2024(acs_diagnostics)
hierarchy_equality <- assert_hierarchical_2024(acs_diagnostics)
panel_columns <- union(names(acs_full), intersect(panel_schema_additions(), names(acs_diagnostics)))
acs_full <- acs_diagnostics |> select(all_of(panel_columns))
assert_tract_keys(acs_full, union(input_keys_16, input_keys_24_bg_agg),
                  "Hierarchical panel retains the original key union")
```

## 3.3 Calculate change variables and their CVs

### Decision: Level changes are ratios; share / rate changes are percentage-point differences

Calculate changes after source selection. Level changes (`*POST`) are
2024/2016 ratios with positive 2016 baselines; missing values or nonpositive
baselines yield `NA`. `interp_rentPOST` uses selected `interp_rent` over
inflation-adjusted `rentE_16`. Inventory and occupied-renter changes each use
their own count baseline.

Share/rate changes (`*PPC`) are `value_24 - value_16` on the 0–1 scale
(0.01 = one percentage point). Differences keep zero shares valid and are
defined wherever both periods are observed.

Occupied-renter and income change CVs use ratio-MOE propagation. Inventory,
interpolated-rent, and share/rate changes have no MOE/CV.

```{r change-vars}
acs_full <- calc_change_vars(acs_full)

table(acs_full$m_flag_rhuPOST)
table(acs_full$m_flag_rhu_inventoryPOST)

# Quick distribution check on the share / rate percentage-point changes
# (expected range roughly [-1, 1])
summary(acs_full$pctrhuPPC)
summary(acs_full$pctvacPPC)
summary(acs_full$pctrvacPPC)
summary(acs_full$pctsvacPPC)

acs_full <- calc_cv_change_vars(acs_full)

# Refresh the diagnostic copy with the single canonical set of calculations.
stopifnot(identical(acs_full$tr2010_id, acs_diagnostics$tr2010_id))
source_diagnostic_columns <- setdiff(names(acs_diagnostics), names(acs_full))
acs_diagnostics <- bind_cols(acs_full, select(acs_diagnostics, all_of(source_diagnostic_columns)))
```

## 3.4 Summarize coefficients of variation

Review CV distributions for poorly measured levels and changes.

```{r summarize-cv}
print("Summary Stats: CV, 2016 Rental housing units ")
summary(acs_full$rhuCV_16)
print("Summary Stats: CV, 2024 Rental housing units ")
summary(acs_full$rhuCV_24)

print("Summary Stats: CV, 2016 Median rent ")
summary(acs_full$rentCV_16)
print("Summary Stats: CV, Rental housing unit change")
summary(acs_full$rhuPOSTCV)



print("Summary Stats: CV, 2016 Median household income ")
summary(acs_full$med_hhincCV_16)
print("Summary Stats: CV, 2024 Median household income ")
summary(acs_full$med_hhincCV_24)

print("Summary Stats: CV, Median income change")
summary(acs_full$med_hhincPOSTCV)

```

# 4. Review geographic coverage and source-selection QA

## 4.1 Report native and panel coverage separately

Coverage shares use the full labeled universe, including unresolved statuses.
Panel zeros for merge/many-to-many classes do not establish absence because
their 2010 links are omitted; use native 2020 summaries for those classes.
Target-crosswalk counts use native 2020 county membership.

Review `geography_unmatched` and `alignment_coverage` to distinguish absent
links, absent source records, and missing estimates within records.

```{r geography-coverage}
target_tract_geography <- tract_geography |>
  filter(substr(tr2020_id, 3, 5) %in% panel_counties)
report_n(target_tract_geography, "Target-county native 2020 crosswalk (coverage only)")
geography_coverage <- list(
  statewide_crosswalk = summarize_merge_geography(tract_geography, "Statewide 2020 crosswalk"),
  target_crosswalk = summarize_merge_geography(target_tract_geography, "Target-county 2020 crosswalk"),
  census_input = summarize_merge_geography(acs_24_tract_geography, "2024 Census input, native 2020 keys"),
  full_panel = summarize_merge_geography(acs_diagnostics, "Full 2010 panel, partially resolved statuses")
)
walk(geography_coverage, function(result) {
  print(result$classes, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  print(result$status, n = Inf, width = Inf)
})

geography_unmatched <- list(
  panel_without_status = anti_join(select(acs_full, tr2010_id), geography_links$statuses, by = "tr2010_id"),
  statuses_outside_panel = anti_join(geography_links$statuses, acs_full, by = "tr2010_id"),
  census_without_crosswalk = anti_join(acs_24_tract_diagnostic, tract_geography, by = "tr2020_id"),
  target_crosswalk_without_census = anti_join(target_tract_geography, acs_24_tract_diagnostic, by = "tr2020_id"),
  consistent_panel_without_census = acs_diagnostics |>
    filter(geo_consistent == 1, !in_24_tract) |> select(tr2010_id, tr2020_id),
  consistent_census_outside_panel = geography_links$consistent |>
    semi_join(acs_24_tract_diagnostic, by = "tr2020_id") |>
    anti_join(acs_full, by = "tr2010_id")
)
iwalk(geography_unmatched, function(rows, label) {
  report_n(rows, paste("Unmatched:", label))
  print(head(rows, 20), width = Inf)
})
cat("Complete unmatched-key tables are retained in geography_unmatched; up to 20 rows shown above.\n")

alignment_coverage <- imap_dfr(
  diagnostic_groups(acs_diagnostics, "geo_status", c("consistent", "not_consistent")),
  function(mask, group) {
    x <- acs_diagnostics[mask, ]
    tibble(group = group, n_total = nrow(x),
           n_no_consistent_link = sum(is.na(x$tr2020_id)),
           n_consistent_link_without_census = sum(!is.na(x$tr2020_id) & !x$in_24_tract),
           n_census_record = sum(x$in_24_tract),
           n_census_rent_missing_in_record = sum(x$in_24_tract & is.na(x$rentE_24_tract)),
           n_census_inventory_missing_in_record = sum(x$in_24_tract & is.na(x$rhu_inventoryE_24_tract)),
           n_bg_record_absent = sum(!x$in_24_bg_agg))
  }
)
stopifnot(with(alignment_coverage,
               all(n_no_consistent_link + n_consistent_link_without_census + n_census_record == n_total)))
print(alignment_coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)

native_tract_measure_coverage <- summarize_diagnostic_measures(
  acs_24_tract_geography, c("rentE_24_tract", "rhu_inventoryE_24_tract"),
  "relationship_class", merge_relationship_classes
)
print(native_tract_measure_coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## 4.2 Audit canonical source selection and missingness

Inspect counts and missingness using each source's full assigned group,
including absent source records. `unassigned` must be zero. Review
missing/unexpected geographic flags and selected missing values with observed
alternatives; all fields must pass `hierarchy_equality`.

In `hierarchy_correction_qa`, **before** selects block-group values only for
flag 0; **after** uses the current selection. Both use this run's inputs.
For rows not flagged consistent, confirm that after-selection missingness
matches block-group missingness and no observed block-group values are lost.
An absent source status is explicitly `unresolved`, so its character status
is excluded from this numeric-missingness comparison.

```{r source-selection-qa}
source_selection_qa <- summarize_source_selection(acs_diagnostics)
print(source_selection_qa$counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)
print(source_selection_qa$geography$status, n = Inf, width = Inf)
print(source_selection_qa$missingness, n = Inf, width = Inf)
hierarchy_equality <- assert_hierarchical_2024(acs_diagnostics)
print(filter(hierarchy_equality, measure %in% c("interp_rent", "rhu_inventoryE_24")),
      n = Inf, width = Inf)
cat("All mapped bundles passed source equality; full checks in hierarchy_equality.\n")
hierarchy_correction_qa <- summarize_hierarchy_correction(acs_diagnostics)
cat("Before: old rule reconstructed on this run's inputs; after: corrected canonical values.\n")
print(hierarchy_correction_qa, n = Inf, width = Inf)
stopifnot("Observed block-group values must be retained for all rows not flagged consistent" =
            all(hierarchy_correction_qa$n_bg_observed_canonical_missing_after == 0),
          "Canonical and block-group missingness must agree for those rows" =
            all(with(filter(hierarchy_correction_qa, measure != "rent_status_24"),
                     n_canonical_missing_after == n_not_consistent - n_bg_observed)))
if (any(!acs_full$geo_consistent %in% c(0, 1))) {
  cat("REVIEW: missing/unexpected geographic flags are retained; these rows select block-group measures.\n")
}
```

# 5. Compare 2024 sources and implied changes (diagnostic only)

## 5.1 Compare interpolated rent and rental inventory levels

### Decision: Restrict source comparisons to geographically consistent tracts

Section 5 uses `geo_consistent == 1` so both sources refer to the same tract
geography. `overall` denotes that subset, including missing source records,
estimates, and baselines in coverage denominators. Rent comparisons use
preserved `interp_rent_24_bg_agg` against native `rentE_24_tract`; canonical
`interp_rent` already equals tract rent on these rows.

For comparisons in §§5–6, `x` is the first measure and `y` the second:
differences are `x - y`, absolute differences are `abs(x - y)`, and ratios are
`x / y` for positive `y` (1 indicates agreement). Here, `x` is Census tract and
`y` is block-group aggregate. Inspect `coverage` before interpreting `summaries`;
keyed `values` tables support tract-level review.

Source summaries use available values; paired differences and Pearson
correlations require both. Correlations are `NA` for fewer than two pairs or a
constant measure; empty/all-missing summaries are `NA`.

```{r compare-source-levels}
source_comparison_diagnostics <- acs_diagnostics |> filter(geo_consistent == 1)
report_n(source_comparison_diagnostics, "Consistent tracts for Section 5 source comparisons")
assert_tract_keys(source_comparison_diagnostics,
                  acs_diagnostics$tr2010_id[acs_diagnostics$geo_consistent %in% 1],
                  "Section 5 retains all consistent panel tracts")
source_level_diagnostics <- list(
  interp_rent = compare_diagnostic_measures(source_comparison_diagnostics, "rentE_24_tract", "interp_rent_24_bg_agg"),
  inventory = compare_diagnostic_measures(source_comparison_diagnostics, "rhu_inventoryE_24_tract", "rhu_inventoryE_24_bg_agg")
)
walk(source_level_diagnostics, function(result) {
  print(result$coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  print(result$summaries, n = Inf, width = Inf)
})
```

## 5.2 Compare implied 2016-to-2024 change ratios

Apply §3.3's positive-baseline ratio definition separately to each source.
Both rent sources use inflation-adjusted `rentE_16`; inventory and occupied
renters use their own unadjusted count baselines. Inspect `baseline_coverage`
for missing/nonpositive baselines before interpreting the consistent subset's
change comparisons. Source-specific changes remain notebook diagnostics.

```{r diagnostic-change-vars}
acs_diagnostics <- acs_diagnostics |>
  mutate(
    diag_rentPOST_24_tract = diagnostic_ratio(rentE_24_tract, rentE_16),
    diag_rhu_inventoryPOST_24_tract = diagnostic_ratio(rhu_inventoryE_24_tract, rhu_inventoryE_16),
    diag_rhu_inventoryPOST_24_bg_agg = diagnostic_ratio(rhu_inventoryE_24_bg_agg, rhu_inventoryE_16),
    diag_rhuPOST_24_tract = diagnostic_ratio(rhuE_24_tract, rhuE_16),
    diag_rhuPOST_24_bg_agg = diagnostic_ratio(rhuE_24_bg_agg, rhuE_16)
  )
source_comparison_diagnostics <- acs_diagnostics |>
  filter(geo_consistent == 1) |>
  mutate(diag_interp_rentPOST_24_bg_agg = diagnostic_ratio(interp_rent_24_bg_agg, rentE_16))
report_n(source_comparison_diagnostics, "Consistent tracts for Section 5 implied-change comparisons")
baseline_coverage <- imap_dfr(
  diagnostic_groups(source_comparison_diagnostics),
  function(mask, group) {
    map_dfr(c("rentE_16", "rhu_inventoryE_16", "rhuE_16"), function(measure) {
      x <- source_comparison_diagnostics[[measure]][mask]
      tibble(group = group, measure = measure, n_total = length(x),
             n_base_missing = sum(is.na(x)), n_base_nonpositive = sum(x <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
             n_base_positive = sum(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
    })
  }
)
stopifnot(with(baseline_coverage, all(n_base_missing + n_base_nonpositive + n_base_positive == n_total)))
print(baseline_coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
source_change_diagnostics <- list(
  interp_rent = compare_diagnostic_measures(source_comparison_diagnostics, "diag_rentPOST_24_tract", "diag_interp_rentPOST_24_bg_agg"),
  inventory = compare_diagnostic_measures(source_comparison_diagnostics, "diag_rhu_inventoryPOST_24_tract", "diag_rhu_inventoryPOST_24_bg_agg")
)
walk(source_change_diagnostics, function(result) {
  print(result$coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  print(result$summaries, n = Inf, width = Inf)
})
```

# 6. Compare occupied renter units and rental inventory (diagnostic only)

## 6.1 Compare concepts within each native source and vintage

`rhu_inventoryE` includes occupied renters (`rhuE`), vacant for rent, and rented,
not occupied units. Use saved inventory: block-group components use `wt_renthu`
and cannot be reconstructed from housing-weighted vacancy fields.

Each table covers its entire native input, regardless of geographic consistency.
Here `x` is inventory and `y` is occupied renters. Review inventory below occupied
units in the keyed `values` tables; `share_x_below_y` uses `n_paired` as its
denominator. Zero occupied counts enter differences and paired counts but have
undefined ratios.

```{r compare-inventory-levels}
inventory_level_diagnostics <- list(
  tract_2016 = compare_diagnostic_measures(acs_16_diagnostic, "rhu_inventoryE_16", "rhuE_16"),
  bg_agg_2024 = compare_diagnostic_measures(acs_24_bg_agg_diagnostic, "rhu_inventoryE_24_bg_agg", "rhuE_24_bg_agg"),
  tract_2024 = compare_diagnostic_measures(acs_24_tract_diagnostic, "rhu_inventoryE_24_tract", "rhuE_24_tract")
)
iwalk(inventory_level_diagnostics, function(result, label) {
  cat("Native input:", label, "\n")
  print(result$coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  print(result$summaries, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  if (any(result$coverage$n_x_below_y > 0)) {
    cat("REVIEW: inventory below occupied renter units; inspect this result's values table.\n")
  }
})
```

## 6.2 Compare inventory change with occupied-renter change

Use the full panel for block-group changes and the consistent subset for Census
changes. Here `x` is inventory change and `y` is occupied-renter change;
differences compare ratios. Canonical `rhuPOST` measures occupied-renter change.

```{r compare-inventory-changes}
consistent_diagnostics <- acs_diagnostics |> filter(geo_consistent == 1)
report_n(consistent_diagnostics, "Consistent subset for Census concept-change diagnostics only")
inventory_change_diagnostics <- list(
  bg_agg_full_panel = compare_diagnostic_measures(
    acs_diagnostics, "diag_rhu_inventoryPOST_24_bg_agg", "diag_rhuPOST_24_bg_agg"),
  tract_consistent = compare_diagnostic_measures(
    consistent_diagnostics, "diag_rhu_inventoryPOST_24_tract", "diag_rhuPOST_24_tract")
)
walk(inventory_change_diagnostics, function(result) {
  print(result$coverage, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  print(result$summaries, n = Inf, width = Inf)
})
```

# 7. Validate the panel and optionally save

Validate the current in-memory panel before the optional save.

```{r validation-panel}
acs_out <- acs_full
assert_rent_metadata(acs_out, "rentE_16", "16", 3500 * inflation_factor_2016())
assert_rent_metadata(acs_out, "interp_rent", "24")
stopifnot("Confirmed top-codes must not enter numeric rent changes" = all(is.na(
  acs_out$interp_rentPOST[acs_out$tc_flag_rent_16 %in% 1 | acs_out$tc_flag_rent_24 %in% 1])))
print(dplyr::count(acs_out, rent_status_16, rent_status_24), n = Inf)
assert_panel_schema(acs_out)
hierarchy_equality <- assert_hierarchical_2024(acs_diagnostics)
assert_tract_keys(acs_diagnostics, acs_full$tr2010_id, "Diagnostic panel retains all canonical keys")
stopifnot("Diagnostic work must preserve every canonical column and value" =
            identical(select(acs_diagnostics, all_of(names(acs_full))), acs_full))
for (source in c("tract", "bg_agg")) {
  mask <- acs_full$acs_source_24 %in% source
  for (measure in c("rhu", "rhu_inventory")) {
    stopifnot("Canonical change must equal the selected diagnostic change" =
      isTRUE(all.equal(acs_full[[paste0(measure, "POST")]][mask],
                      acs_diagnostics[[paste0("diag_", measure, "POST_24_", source)]][mask])))
  }
}
stopifnot("Interpolated rent change must use the canonical selected value" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(acs_full$interp_rentPOST,
                             diagnostic_ratio(acs_full$interp_rent, acs_full$rentE_16),
                             tolerance = 0)))
stopifnot("Every panel row must have an assigned 2024 source" =
            !anyNA(acs_full$acs_source_24))
```

## 7.1 Check key uniqueness and duplicates

Confirm one row per `tr2010_id`, the full input-key union, and all 14 counties.

```{r validate-keys-panel}
cat("acs_full:", nrow(acs_out), "rows |",
    n_distinct(acs_out$tr2010_id), "unique tr2010_id |",
    sum(duplicated(acs_out$tr2010_id)), "duplicate ids\n")
validated_panel_membership <- audit_panel_keys(acs_out, input_keys_16, input_keys_24_bg_agg)
report_tract_counties(acs_out, panel_counties, "In-memory panel destination counties")
```

## 7.2 Check missingness on critical variables

Keys must be complete. Review measure missingness against selected-source
availability and, for change ratios, missing/nonpositive baselines. No empirical
missingness threshold is imposed; inspect structure-count levels separately.

```{r validate-missingness-panel}
cat("acs_full missing tr2010_id:    ", sum(is.na(acs_out$tr2010_id)), "\n")
cat("acs_full missing rentE_16:     ", sum(is.na(acs_out$rentE_16)), "\n")
cat("acs_full missing inventory 2016:", sum(is.na(acs_out$rhu_inventoryE_16)), "\n")
cat("acs_full missing inventory 2024:", sum(is.na(acs_out$rhu_inventoryE_24)), "\n")
cat("acs_full missing inventory change:", sum(is.na(acs_out$rhu_inventoryPOST)), "\n")

cat("acs_full missing inventory 2024:", sum(is.na(acs_out$rhu_inventoryE_24)), "\n")
cat("acs_full missing interp_rent:", sum(is.na(acs_out$interp_rent)), "\n")
cat("acs_full missing interp_rentPOST:", sum(is.na(acs_out$interp_rentPOST)), "\n")
for (column in c("smfE_16", "smfE_24", "sfd_detE_16", "sfd_detE_24")) {
  cat("acs_full missing", column, ":", sum(is.na(acs_out[[column]])), "\n")
}
print(summarize_diagnostic_measures(
  acs_diagnostics, c("rentE_24_tract", "interp_rent_24_bg_agg", "rhu_inventoryE_16",
                     "rhu_inventoryE_24_tract", "rhu_inventoryE_24_bg_agg")
), n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## 7.3 Check flag-variable encoding

Observed quality/change flags must be numeric 0/1; join indicators are logical.
Use the input-key audit in §7.1 to interpret membership.

```{r validate-flags-panel}
flag_cols <- grep("^(m_flag_|zero_flag_|tc_flag_)", names(acs_out), value = TRUE)
for (f in flag_cols) {
  cat("acs_full", f, "-> class:", class(acs_out[[f]]),
      "| values:", paste(sort(unique(acs_out[[f]])), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cat("acs_full base_id class:", class(acs_out$base_id),
    "| post_id class:", class(acs_out$post_id), "\n")
```

## 7.4 Summarize numeric variable distributions

Review negative counts, shares outside [0, 1], and implausible change ratios.
Fractional allocated counts are valid; `*PPC` differences may be negative.

```{r validate-numeric-panel}
print_numeric_summary(acs_out, "acs_full")
```

## 7.5 Optionally save and validate the canonical output

After reviewing diagnostics with writing disabled, set `write_panel <- TRUE`
in §1.3 and rerun from setup to save. The prior panel supplies a schema
reference; a missing reference leaves that comparison unchecked. Allowed schema
differences are documented in the [panel schema](schemas/acs_full.md).
After writing, reload validation checks keys, column order/types, and all values.

```{r save-panel}
panel_written <- FALSE
if (isTRUE(write_panel)) {
  report_n(acs_full, "Canonical ACS tract panel to save")
  audit_panel_keys(acs_full, input_keys_16, input_keys_24_bg_agg)
  report_tract_counties(acs_full, panel_counties, "Final panel destination counties")
  assert_panel_schema(acs_full, prior_panel)
  if (is.null(prior_panel)) {
    cat("Prior panel schema comparison not checked: no existing acs_full.feather at setup.\n")
  }
  cat("Writing/replacing", file.path(data_dir, "acs_full.feather"), "\n")
  arrow::write_feather(acs_full, file.path(data_dir, "acs_full.feather"))
  panel_written <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("Canonical write disabled: validated in-memory panel; no output replaced.\n")
}
```

```{r reload-panel}
if (isTRUE(panel_written)) {
  acs_saved <- arrow::read_feather(file.path(data_dir, "acs_full.feather"))
  saved_panel_membership <- audit_panel_keys(acs_saved, input_keys_16, input_keys_24_bg_agg)
  report_tract_counties(acs_saved, panel_counties, "Saved panel destination counties")
  assert_same_schema(acs_saved, acs_full, "Saved panel schema")
  stopifnot("Saved panel values must agree with the validated in-memory panel" =
              isTRUE(all.equal(acs_saved, acs_full)))
} else {
  cat("Reload skipped: this run did not write a canonical panel.\n")
}
```
